touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: North Rauceby qualifies as a local detour through PARISH CHURCH OF ST PETER and North Rauceby village cross. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: North Rauceby: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander

suggestedFirstVisit.title: PARISH CHURCH OF ST PETER
